_readme: Production from leagues FPL's API doesn't cover.
This is NOT a general override file. It applies ONLY to players with no
measured Premier League season — projections.py REFUSES to apply an entry
to anyone who already has PL data, and says so when it does.
Supply a real season as raw counts. The code converts to per-90 and
applies a league-strength multiplier (see LEAGUE_STRENGTH in
projections.py). Goals and assists stand in for xG and xA.
Fields:
league    ligue1 | la_liga | bundesliga | serie_a | eredivisie |
primeira_liga | belgian_pro | super_lig | championship |
mls | other
minutes   league minutes that season (450 minimum)
starts    league starts
goals     league goals
assists   league assists
defcon90  OPTIONAL, only if you have a real figure. DefCon isn't
published outside the PL, so leave it out and the positional
prior applies.
note      free text, echoed when applied
A foreign season is capped at 75% confidence however many minutes it
covers — different league, different tactics, different opposition.
DELETE an entry once the player has a real Premier League season behind
him. At that point the code refuses it anyway, but a stale file is still
noise. Prefer player ids; ambiguous names are refused.

DO NOT invent numbers. An entry with made-up minutes and goals is worse than the price heuristic it replaces, because it looks authoritative. Pull from FBref or Transfermarkt and leave a player out if you can't find his league season.

Barcola.note: Liverpool GBP106m from PSG. 24 goal contributions in 34 Ligue 1 apps 2024/25. Clear minutes path at Anfield vs fighting Dembele/Doue/Kvaratskhelia at PSG.

646.note: Malick Fofana (SUN MID, id 646 — NOT Wesley Fofana id 145 at Chelsea). Sunderland GBP30m from Lyon. Chiefly left winger. 2025/26 cut short by ankle surgery (754 min), so 2024/25 is the fuller reference season.
